_comment:
Captions for the App Store iPhone sets (build-appstore-iphone.mjs): per app, language and screen, the headline (
breaks it, is its highlighted line), the line under the phone, its chips ([emoji, words]) and the footnote. The heroes (01, 02) take hero_strings.json and anon_hero_strings.json. Every chip names something the app really does; the survival kit and Moniker are the app's own words in each language.
